newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam jails Taiwanese for arms trafficking.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam jails Taiwanese for arms trafficking.

text.p: Vietnam has jailed two Taiwanese men and a Vietnamese woman on arms trafficking charges following the discovery of handguns and ammunition inside boxes of seafood due for export, the Tuoi Tre newspaper said on Saturday.

The report said Huan Kuei Fa and Huan Yue Yun were jailed for 12 and 10 years respectively by a Ho Chi Minh City court on Friday. Their Vietnamese accomplice Lam Thi Mo Thu was given an eight year term.
The newspaper gave few details but said Yun had bought six pistols and 33 bullets in Cambodia and brought them into Vietnam.
The guns were discovered inside crates of seafood bound for Taiwan.
Taiwan is a major investor in Vietnam but does not have formal diplomatic representation.
Court officials were not available for comment on Saturday.
